options.plan: Upstream release 26.8.0; commercial support not assessed
options.region: Operator-selected hosting; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Operator-selected primary DB, event logging and backup/export storage; no federation, custom providers or hosted service

conditions: Select upstream self-hosted Keycloak with native local users and an operator-selected relational database. No LDAP, upstream identity provider, custom User Storage SPI or managed Keycloak service is included.

Database configuration identifies a storage mechanism, not a country. Primary storage, replicas, snapshots, exports and operator destinations are unverified; coverage remains UNKNOWN with an empty country list.

User caches and default persisted sessions are separate from a verified at-rest inventory: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/blob/4246609cf2024c85016d3fb1254c3d2533367c31/docs/guides/server/caching.adoc. No hosting country or data-localization guarantee is inferred.

evidence.summary: The database guide describes relational storage for user, client and realm data. Actual operator-controlled destinations and completeness are unverified; no country is recorded.

conditions: The at-rest section includes hashed user passwords, client credentials and realm signing keys in the database. Hashing and recommended encryption do not identify storage countries or prove encryption is enabled.

Include relevant database files, WAL/redo copies and backup storage in a separate deployment inventory. Key management and any provider-specific credential stores require independent evidence; this scope excludes external federation and custom storage providers.

Coverage stays UNKNOWN with no destinations. A self-hosted product label, TLS connection or operator-selected region is not proof that every credential copy stays inside an allowlist. No deployment, credential inspection or encryption setting was changed.

evidence.summary: The pinned guide identifies sensitive database data and requires attention to WAL and backups. This establishes investigation targets, not observed geography, at-rest encryption or complete credential coverage.

conditions: User-event persistence is configurable and not enabled by default; selected event types, expiration and listeners matter. Unknown log destinations do not mean no logs exist, and this residency record does not certify event completeness, retention or immutability.

Admin-event storage is a separate setting and can include representations: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/blob/4246609cf2024c85016d3fb1254c3d2533367c31/docs/documentation/server_admin/topics/events/admin.adoc. Its database, replicas and copied records need separate destination evidence.

Console, file and Syslog handlers route output differently: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/blob/4246609cf2024c85016d3fb1254c3d2533367c31/docs/guides/server/logging.adoc. A console stream can be persisted by its runtime; local paths and collector endpoints do not identify countries.

Review event DBs, disk files, runtime collectors, downstream log stores and their copies. Coverage remains UNKNOWN with no countries; no event setting, collector, retention rule or live log retrieval was performed.

evidence.summary: The user-event guide describes opt-in persistence and listener behavior. Actual event databases and logging destinations are unverified; this does not establish auditing capabilities or country coverage.

conditions: Realm export is not a complete backup: it excludes user/admin events, persisted sessions, workflow state and revoked tokens. Export consistency requires stopped nodes; this is documentation, not authorization to stop an installation or run export/import.

Admin Console partial export excludes users and masks sensitive values; it is not suitable as a complete backup. No masked export or local JSON file proves complete recovery coverage or a storage country.

Database backups, WAL archives, snapshots, replicas and CLI export copies need their own operator inventory of destinations, retention, encryption and recovery evidence. Exact completeness and countries are unverified; coverage stays UNKNOWN with an empty list.

No backup, export, restore, snapshot, cloud storage, account, subscription or deployment was created. No paid service or measured recovery objective is inferred; AuthWeave's ZITADEL/BFF, UI and synthetic evaluator are unchanged.

evidence.summary: The pinned import/export guide documents consistency and omitted-state limits, including partial Admin Console exports. Actual backup destinations and recovery coverage are unverified; no country or complete backup claim is proposed.
